name: Soltendieck (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided white over green, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Soltendieck (crossed tools and ears on red between green and waves).
history: Municipal flag of Soltendieck; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Soltendieck arms — tools, ears and waves
